editorial.blurb: Hibachi Go delivers restaurant-quality hibachi plates with generous portions and vibrant flavors at prices that feel like a steal.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead for easy ordering and pickup—reviewers rave about the seamless phone experience, and the combo plates (like chicken & beef or steak & shrimp) are packed with food for around $16.
